cards.ex: Her fixation on social media was starting to affect her real-life relationships.
cards.exUz: Uning ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga qattiq bog'lanishi uning haqiqiy hayotdagi munosabatlariga ta'sir qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaga haddan tashqari qiziqish yoki bog'lanib qolish holati.

cards.ex: His preoccupation with work left him little time for his family.
cards.exUz: Uning ish bilan g'oyibona fikrlashi unga oilasi uchun kam vaqt qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa haqida tinimsiz o'ylash, xayolan band bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was completely under the spell of the casino, losing more and more money.
cards.exUz: U butunlay kazino ta'siri ostida edi va tobora ko'p pul yo'qotardi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kuchli, ko'pincha salbiy ta'siri ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was in the throes of withdrawal after stopping the medication.
cards.exUz: U dori vositalarini to'xtatgandan so'ng voz kechish azobida edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir qattiq va og'riqli ta'siri ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company had an insatiable appetite for profits, even at the expense of its workers.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning foydaga bo'lgan to'ymas ishtahasi hatto o'z ishchilarining hisobidan ham qondirilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon qondirib bo'lmaydigan, doimo ko'proq narsani xohlaydigan ishtaha.

cards.ex: His compulsive behavior included constantly checking if the door was locked.
cards.exUz: Uning majburiy xatti-harakatiga doimiy ravishda eshik qulflanganligini tekshirish kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda takrorlanadigan, nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: The cult had a strong hold on its members, controlling every aspect of their lives.
cards.exUz: Mazhab o'z a'zolari ustidan kuchli hukmronlik qilib, ularning hayotining har bir jabhasini nazorat qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikri yoki xatti-harakatlari ustidan kuchli ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: For him, success was just a means to an end – the ability to retire early.
cards.exUz: U uchun muvaffaqiyat shunchaki maqsadga erishish vositasi edi - erta pensiyaga chiqish imkoniyati.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun foydalaniladigan usul yoki vosita, o'zi aslida yoqimsiz bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He bought the expensive car just to scratch the itch of wanting something new.
cards.exUz: U yangi narsa xohishini qondirish uchun qimmatbaho mashinani sotib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Hohish yoki ehtiyojni qondirish, ayniqsa qisqa muddatli.

cards.ex: He was caught in the web of debt, unable to see a way out.
cards.exUz: U qarzlar to'riga tushib qoldi va undan chiqish yo'lini ko'ra olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir murakkab va qiyin vaziyatiga tushib qolish.

cards.ex: She developed an obsession with healthy eating, which eventually became unhealthy.
cards.exUz: U sog'lom ovqatlanishga o'ch paydo qildi, bu oxir-oqibatda nosog'lom bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga nisbatan haddan tashqari qiziqish yoki bog'lanish paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: His relentless pursuit of perfection made him a very demanding boss.
cards.exUz: Uning mukammallikka tinimsiz intilishi uni juda talabchan boshliqqa aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir to'xtovsiz, qat'iyat bilan erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She had a burning passion for music from a very young age.
cards.exUz: U juda yoshligidan musiqaga nisbatan olovli ishtiyoqqa ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari kuchli qiziqish yoki ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: His stamp collection became a consuming interest in his retirement.
cards.exUz: Uning pochta markalarini to'plashi nafaqaga chiqqanidan keyin to'liq qiziqishga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Butun e'tiborni tortadigan va vaqtni egallaydigan qiziqish.

cards.ex: Their affair was a fatal attraction that destroyed both of their marriages.
cards.exUz: Ularning ishqiy munosabatlari xavfli muhabbat bo'lib, ularning ikkala nikohini ham buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Oqibatlari xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan kuchli, ammo zararli qiziqish.

cards.ex: The psychiatrist diagnosed her with borderline personality disorder after a series of emotional outbursts.
cards.exUz: Psixiatr bir qator hissiy portlashlardan so'ng unga chegaraviy shaxs buzilishi tashxisini qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Barqaror bo'lmagan munosabatlar, o'zini his qilish va kayfiyat bilan bog'liq psixologik holat.

cards.ex: He suffered from obsessive thoughts about germs and cleanliness.
cards.exUz: U mikroblar va tozalik haqida o'ychan fikrlardan aziyat chekardi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda takrorlanadigan, istalmagan va bezovta qiluvchi fikrlar.

cards.ex: Smoking was an entrenched habit that he struggled to break.
cards.exUz: Chekish uning buzishga harakat qilgan o'rnashib qolgan odati edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan o'zgartirilishi mumkin bo'lgan, chuqur ildiz otgan odat.

cards.ex: She developed a dependence on sleeping pills after a period of insomnia.
cards.exUz: U uyqusizlikdan keyin uxlash tabletkalariga qaramlikni rivojlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga jismoniy yoki ruhiy qaramlikni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: His mother had a controlling influence over his life, even into adulthood.
cards.exUz: Uning onasi hatto voyaga yetganida ham uning hayoti ustidan nazorat qiluvchi ta'sirga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir hayoti yoki xatti-harakatlari ustidan kuchli nazorat qiluvchi ta'sir.

cards.ex: She could lose herself in a good book for hours.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi kitobda soatlab o'zini yo'qotib qo'yishi mumkin edi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini butunlay nimagadir berib yuborish, unda erib ketish.

cards.ex: His actions were driven by a desire for revenge.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari qasos olish istagi bilan harakatlantirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning kuchli ta'siri ostida bo'lish, maqsad sari yetaklash.

cards.ex: Many people fall under the sway of advertising and buy things they don't need.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar reklama ta'siri ostiga tushib, ularga kerak bo'lmagan narsalarni sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yoki nimaningdir ta'siri ostiga tushib qolish.

cards.ex: The lure of easy money can be a siren song that leads people into trouble.
cards.exUz: Oson pulning jozibasi odamlarni muammoga olib keladigan aldaydigan qo'shiq bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jozibali, lekin xavfli taklif yoki vasvasa.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get a handle on my spending habits.
cards.exUz: Men o'z xarajatlarimni nazoratga olishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tushunish va nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: His life took a quick descent after he started gambling.
cards.exUz: U qimor o'ynay boshlaganidan keyin uning hayoti tezda yomonlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Holatning tez yomonlashuvi, ko'pincha salbiy oqibatlar bilan.

cards.ex: He was in denial about his drinking problem, even though everyone could see it.
cards.exUz: Hamma ko'rsa ham, u ichkilik muammosi haqida inkorda edi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning mavjudligini tan olmaslik.

cards.ex: Her compassion was the chink in her armor that her enemies exploited.
cards.exUz: Uning rahm-shafqati uning dushmanlari foydalangan himoyasidagi teshik edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir zaif tomoni yoki himoyasidagi kamchilik.

cards.ex: Some people believed he was beyond redemption after his crimes.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar uning jinoyatlaridan keyin uni tuzatib bo'lmas deb hisoblashdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirib yoki tuzatib bo'lmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: He felt like a lost soul after his divorce.
cards.exUz: U ajrashgandan keyin o'zini ado bo'lgan ruhdek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotida yo'lini yo'qotgan, baxtsiz va yolg'iz inson.
